info.title: noticeforge
info.description: Generates a third-party notices file from a .NET publish folder, using the original license texts, and fails the build on unknown or disallowed licenses.

commands.name: check
commands.description: check the licenses of every locked dependency

options.name: --config
options.description:
noticeforge.json (allowed licenses, per-package overrides, extra components);
both commands use the same file, and both check the extras

options.name: --report
options.description: also write the report as JSON (for tools; the screen report stays text)

options.name: --cache
options.description:
where texts fetched from GitHub are kept, per commit
(default: %LOCALAPPDATA%/NoticeForge/cache or ~/.local/share/NoticeForge/cache)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description:
always fetch from GitHub and keep nothing
environment:
GITHUB_TOKEN         used for GitHub API requests (60 -> 5,000 requests per hour)
exit code: 0 = ok, 1 = problems found, 2 = usage or input error

commands.name: notices
commands.description: write the notices file for what is distributed
